title: Eye icon positioning fix
changes: Fixed the balance-hide eye icon rendering top-left instead of top-right — a competing style rule was silently overriding its position
Repositioned it to the right side, vertically centered on the balance card

title: Balance privacy toggle + a correction
changes: New eye icon on the balance card — tap to hide the balance, income/expense totals, and net worth (masked with dots), tap again to reveal. Remembered across sessions.

Correction: v1.28.0's changelog listed three timezone bugs as fixed, but the underlying code fix hadn't actually been applied — they're genuinely fixed now (bank CSV import dates, recurring transaction day-of-month, and Stats' week/month bucketing, all for anyone west of UTC)

title: Bug fixes + PDF reports now show the full picture
changes: Fixed a timezone bug: a bank CSV date near midnight could import one day earlier than the statement actually showed, for anyone west of UTC
Fixed a related bug where a recurring transaction's day-of-month could be miscalculated by one day for the same reason — most noticeable on bills set for the 1st
Fixed the same class of bug in Stats' monthly/yearly charts, which could file a transaction into the wrong week or month near a boundary
PDF reports now include a Financial Position section: current net worth, plus savings goal and debt progress bars — not just period income/expense
Onboarding tour updated to mention receipt photos, Upcoming Transactions, and CSV import

title: Upcoming Transactions
changes: Log a transaction dated in the future and it won't affect your balance, budgets, or stats until that day actually arrives — no separate "pending" step needed
New "Upcoming Transactions" section on the dashboard, above Recent Activity, showing what's scheduled
Tap it to see the full list and add new upcoming entries directly from there
Upcoming transactions stay out of Recent Activity and Search until their date arrives, keeping both focused on what's actually happened

title: Back to autoupdate
changes: Reverted to fully automatic updates — a new version applies itself and the app reloads once, with no prompt
Removed the "Update" / "Later" toast and the matching Settings button from the last release
The existing "What's New" sheet still shows automatically after an update, so you'll always see what changed

title: Update, on your terms
changes: The update toast now has two buttons: "Update" to apply it now, or "Later" to keep using the app as-is
A matching "Update available" button now lives in Settings → General → About, so it's never lost if you dismiss the toast
An update you defer still applies automatically the next time you fully close and reopen the app

title: Header polish, easier logout, redesigned PDF reports
changes: Profile tiles now show a two-line name at matching size; the dashboard header shows the full name on one line, larger
Account type now reads "Personal Account" / "Business Account"
Log out moved to the Settings home screen — no need to open General first
Fixed a real bug: PDF reports showed garbled "±" characters instead of the peso sign and minus sign, caused by fonts that can't render them — amounts now use plain currency codes instead
PDF reports redesigned: branded header, a name/account-type card, colored income/expense/net summary cards, and a colored bar chart for category breakdown
Backup export/restore now includes budgets and recurring transaction rules, which were previously silently dropped

title: Rename profiles, log out, two-word names
changes: Rename a profile anytime from Settings → General
"Switch profile" is now labeled "Log out" — same action, clearer wording
Profile names can now be two words; the second word (e.g. a last name) shows smaller, below the first

title: Goal & debt history, About screen
changes: Tap any savings goal or debt to see its full history of contributions or payments, each with a date and optional note
Debts now show a payoff progress bar, based on the total amount you started with
History entries can be deleted, correctly reversing their effect on the running total
Settings → General → About now shows the app version and a full "What's new" history, not just the latest update

title: Starting balance
changes: Set a starting balance when creating a new profile, or on any account afterward — money you already had, not counted as income
Tap any account in Settings to rename it or adjust its starting balance

title: Balance trend and consistent confirmations
changes: A 30-day balance trend now sits behind the balance card, green when you're up over the month and red when you're down
Delete confirmations follow two consistent rules: type a code for profiles, accounts, and transactions; tap twice for categories, tags, goals, and debts

title: Duplicate protection and faster refreshes
changes: CSV import now flags rows already in your records and skips them, so re-importing the same statement won't double your data
Restoring the same backup twice no longer duplicates transactions
Dashboard refreshes are faster on password-protected profiles with a lot of history

title: Settings, reorganized
changes: Settings is now grouped into General, Money, Planning, and Data & Security instead of one long scrolling list
Every existing setting is still there — just organized so it's actually findable

title: Tag filtering, CSV import, welcome tour
changes: Filter transaction search by tag, and see a "Top tags" spending breakdown in Stats
Import transactions from a bank or e-wallet CSV export, with column mapping and a preview before committing
A short first-time welcome tour covering what the app can do, replayable anytime from Settings

title: Savings goals, debts, and tags
changes: Track savings goals with a target and manual progress — separate from your actual balance, so nothing gets double-counted
Track debts (loans, credit cards) with a running balance and payment logging
Net worth now shows on the dashboard once you have a debt tracked
Add custom tags to transactions, separate from categories, creatable right from the add-transaction screen

title: Safer deletes, reorderable accounts
changes: Deleting an account now requires typing a confirmation code, same as deleting a profile
Drag accounts by the handle in Settings to reorder them
Deleting a transaction (from the edit screen or by swiping) now requires a 4-digit confirmation code

title: Profile photos, category cleanup, tablet support
changes: Add a profile photo, with drag-to-position and pinch/slider zoom cropping
Delete categories you no longer need from Settings
Recovery words screen now has a one-tap Copy button
Delete a profile entirely from the profile screen, with a random confirmation code to prevent accidents
Works properly in landscape and on tablets

title: Accounts, swipe-to-delete, shortcuts, receipts
changes: Track money across multiple accounts (Cash, Bank, GCash...) per profile, with a balance breakdown on the dashboard
Swipe any transaction left to delete it
Long-press the app icon for an "Add expense" shortcut
Attach a receipt photo to any transaction, viewable anytime from the edit screen

title: Category icons
changes: Categories now show a colored icon instead of a plain dot, everywhere they appear
Settings → Categories lets you change any category's icon or color
Add your own custom categories with a name, icon, and color

title: Search transactions
changes: "See all" on the dashboard opens a full searchable transaction history
Filter by income/expense, category, or a date range
Search matches category and note text

title: Recurring transactions
changes: Check "Repeat monthly" on any new transaction to have it auto-added every month
Manage or stop recurring transactions from Settings

title: Budgets
changes: Set a monthly limit per expense category in Settings
Dashboard now shows a budget progress list, with a warning color as you approach or exceed a limit

title: Edit, delete, and backup
changes: Tap any transaction to edit or delete it
Export a backup of your data anytime from Settings
Restore transactions from a backup file

title: Final packaging
changes: Proper PNG app icons for iOS and Android home screens, alongside the scalable icon
Final deployment checks before launch

title: Polish pass
changes: New branded loading screen on open and right after unlocking
Smoother transitions across tabs, sheets, and buttons throughout
Balance now counts up instead of snapping to the new number
What's New — see it anytime from the profile screen

title: PDF reports
changes: Weekly and monthly reports with income/expense summary, category breakdown, and full transaction list
Business profiles get a tax-deductible total in their reports
One-tap PDF download, generated entirely on your device

title: Statistics
changes: Category breakdown chart and income vs expense trend, by week, month, or year
Top 3 spending categories at a glance

title: Password protection
changes: Optional password protection per profile, with real encryption of your data
12-word recovery phrase in case you forget your password
A new lockscreen for password-protected profiles

title: Dashboard is live
changes: Add income and expenses with categories, notes, and dates
See total balance and recent activity at a glance
Check yesterday's activity with one tap
Settings tab with live theme switching

title: Multiple profiles
changes: Add separate profiles for Personal, Business, or anyone else
Each profile keeps fully separate records
Default categories are seeded automatically based on profile type

title: Welcome to Vault
changes: Track income and expenses, offline and installed like a real app
Dashboard with today's balance and recent activity
Dark and light mode
